description: PII test suite for RQ2 — gateway-level enforcement evaluation. 52 cases covering true positives, true negatives, edge cases, and adversarial variants.

expected_outcomes.BLOCK: HTTP 401 Unauthorized — PII detected, request rejected at Flex Gateway
expected_outcomes.PASS: HTTP 200 OK — no PII detected, request processed normally
